topic: Korea's public snow boxes and the clear-your-own-sidewalk rule. Seoul places 제설함 (snow-removal boxes) on steep streets, alleys and other icing spots; they hold de-icer (calcium chloride) and sand, sometimes shovels, contents and colour vary by district, and anyone may use them; locations are mapped on 서울안전누리 and the 서울안전 app (Seoul media hub, 2022-12-21, updated 2023-11-20). Seoul inspected 12,679 snow boxes in 2019. Natural Disaster Countermeasures Act Art. 27: building owners/occupants/managers must clear snow and ice on the sidewalk, back lanes and pedestrian paths around their building; details by local ordinance. Gangnam-gu ordinance Art. 5: within 4 hours after snow stops in daytime, by 11 a.m. next day at night, 24 hours if 10 cm+ fell in a day; Art. 4: sidewalk along the lot, 1 m from the lot line on back lanes. No fine in the Act; liability for injuries can follow. Seoul winter 2025-26: road heating wires 928 sites, brine sprayers 533 sites (Seoul explainer 2025-12-23); 1,096 snow trucks, about 80,000 t of de-icer (winter plan 2025-11-15 to 2026-03-15); 5 cm+ forecast means pre-treatment done 3 hours before rush hour.
title: In Korea, the Street Hands You Salt for the Snow

slides.kicker: FREE DE-ICER. ON THE STREET CORNER.
slides.headline: In Korea, the street **hands you salt** for the snow.
slides.note: Boxes of de-icer and sand sit on hills and alleys. Anyone can open one.

slides.headline: The box **on the corner**
slides.body: Steep streets, alley corners and other spots that ice over get a snow box. Inside: bags of de-icing salt or sand, sometimes a shovel. Colors and contents differ by district.

slides.headline: No key. **No form.**
slides.body: Anyone can lift the lid and use it. When snow trucks can't fit up a narrow lane, people living there spread it themselves. Seoul's safety app and website map every box.

slides.headline: snow boxes **checked in Seoul**
slides.body: That's how many snow boxes the city inspected before winter in 2019, one at a time, in the spots most likely to freeze.

slides.headline: Your sidewalk, **your job**
slides.body: National law says the people who own or live in a building must clear the snow and ice on the sidewalk and back lanes around it. Each city fills in the details.

slides.headline: The **4-hour** rule
slides.body: In Seoul's Gangnam district: clear it within 4 hours after the snow stops in the day. If it stops at night, by 11 a.m. the next day. After 10 cm or more, within 24 hours.

slides.headline: No fine, **but**
slides.body: The law sets no fine for skipping it. But if someone slips on the snow in front of your building, you can be held responsible. So most people grab a shovel.

slides.headline: Roads that **melt it first**
slides.body: Last winter Seoul ran heating wires under steep roads at 928 spots and salt-water sprayers at 533 more. They switch on before the ice can set.

slides.headline: Done **before rush hour**
slides.body: When 5 cm or more is forecast, Seoul has to pre-treat main roads 3 hours before people head to work. It keeps 1,096 snow trucks and about 80,000 tons of de-icer ready.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.

caption:
In Korea, the street hands you salt for the snow.

Boxes of de-icer and sand sit on steep streets and alley corners, and anyone can open one. The catch: by law, the snow in front of your building is yours to clear.

Who clears the sidewalk where you live?
reply: Travel tip: if you spot a snow box at the bottom of a hill in Korea, take it as a warning. That slope freezes. Wear shoes with grip, hold the railing, and if you borrow some salt from the box, close the lid so it stays dry for the next person.
fact_check: 1장·2장·3장: 제설함은 누구나 사용, 염화칼슘·모래 등, 자치구마다 삽 등 도구 포함 가능, 색·내용물 자치구마다 다름, 서울안전누리·서울안전앱에서 위치 확인 (서울시 미디어허브 2022-12-21 발행, 2023-11-20 수정). 비상시 제설차 못 오는 곳에서 시민 사용은 서울시 기사 서술.
4장: 서울시 2019년 제설 취약지역 제설함 12,679개 일제점검 (서울시 2019 보도자료, 검색 결과 기준). 현재 개수 아님을 '2019'로 명시.
5장: 자연재해대책법 제27조① 건축물의 소유자·점유자·관리자는 주변 보도·이면도로·보행자 전용도로·지붕 제설·제빙, ② 구체적 범위는 조례 (국가법령정보센터 현행, 2026-01-02 시행본).
6장: 서울특별시 강남구 건축물관리자의 제설·제빙에 관한 조례 제5조① 주간 4시간 이내, 야간 다음 날 오전 11시까지, 1일 10cm 이상이면 24시간 이내 (2020-11-06 제정).
7장: 자연재해대책법 벌칙 조항에 제27조 위반 처벌 없음 (본문 대조). 사고 시 배상 책임은 세계일보 2021-11-30·2024-11-28, 서울시 미디어허브 2025-02-03 서술. 'can be held responsible'로 완화.
8장: 서울시 설명자료 2025-12-23 '자동제설시설(열선 928개소, 염수분사장치 533개소) 확대 운영'. 11월 종합대책 발표 땐 열선 791·염수분사 382였음, 12월 확대 수치 사용.
9장: 5cm 이상 예보 시 출퇴근 3시간 전 사전 제설 완료 (서울시 설명자료 2025-12-23). 제설차량 1,096대·제설제 약 8만 톤 (서울시 2025 겨울철 종합대책, 2025-11-15~2026-03-15).
reply: 생활 조언. 제설함 있는 곳 = 제설 취약지점이라는 점은 1·2장 근거.
